morphology.pattern_note: ter- 表示受吸引后形成的状态；词根首音 p 保留，不发生鼻音同化或脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 被人、事物的魅力吸引而动心、着迷。
senses.en_definition: To be charmed, captivated, or attracted by someone or something.
senses.nuances: 强调内心被打动后的状态，常比 tertarik 更有情感色彩；可用于爱情，也可用于风景、艺术或商品，不必然表示已经爱上或决定购买。terpikat oleh、terpikat dengan 和 terpikat pada 均可依语境使用。定义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=terpikat)。

collocations.en: captivated by the beauty of nature
charmed by his or her smile

senses.zh_definition: 中了诱捕手段而被捕获。
senses.en_definition: To be caught or entrapped by a lure.
senses.ms_definition: Kena pikat atau telah ditangkap dengan menggunakan denak atau umpan.
senses.nuances: 这是 pikat 诱捕义的结果状态，常涉及以诱鸟等引来猎物；现代日常交流中通常不如“动心、着迷”的比喻义常见。不要将它理解为所有形式的抓捕。

collocations.en: a bird caught by a lure
lured and caught using a decoy bird

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Ramai pengunjung terpikat oleh kehalusan hasil tenunan yang dipamerkan dalam pameran tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 许多参观者被该展览中展出的精美织品所吸引。
dual_scenarios.en: Many visitors were captivated by the fine craftsmanship of the textiles on display at the exhibition.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah terpikat dengan beg tu, tapi nak fikir dulu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah terpikat dengan beg itu, tetapi saya mahu mempertimbangkannya dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经看上那个包了，不过还是先考虑一下吧。
dual_scenarios.en: That bag has really caught my eye, but I want to think it over first.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人间使用的第一人称代词
lah 在这里使自我决定的语气更随意

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah terpikat dengan beg kat kedai tadi. Cantik gila!
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah terpikat dengan beg di kedai tadi. Beg itu sangat cantik!
messages.zh: 我看上刚才店里的那个包了，真的超好看！
messages.en: I've fallen for that bag we saw in the shop. It's gorgeous!

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau kau nak, kita tengok harga dulu lah. Jangan terus beli je.
messages.ms_standard: Jika kamu berminat, mari kita semak harganya dahulu. Jangan terus membelinya tanpa pertimbangan.
messages.zh: 你要是想买，我们先看看价钱吧，别直接就下单。
messages.en: If you're interested, let's check the price first. Don't buy it on impulse.

etymology.historical_story: The root pikat connects the practical act of luring birds with the emotional experience of winning someone's interest. DBP records both senses within this word family. Terpikat presents the resulting state: someone or something has been caught by a lure, literally or figuratively. The connection offers a vivid cultural image, although these dictionary meanings alone do not establish which sense developed first. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pikat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pikat 是“引来、吸引”：memikat 是把别人吸引过来，terpikat 是自己的心已经被吸住。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于欣赏景色、工艺和作品时自然得体；直接对人说 Saya terpikat pada awak 通常带有明显的示爱意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 职场评价宜说清被吸引的是设计、创意或成果。评价同事本人或外貌时，terpikat 容易被理解为私人好感。
